## **🎯 UNIQUE RESEARCH OPPORTUNITY INITIATED**

### **Historical Significance**
- **Only official server binary** ever released by Blizzard
- **Accidentally included** in Diablo 2 v1.00 (2000)
- **Never released again** - Removed from all subsequent versions
- **Foundation for all private servers** - D2GS implementations built on this

### **Research Value**
- **Server architecture insights** - Blizzard's original design patterns
- **Network protocol documentation** - Battle.net communication specifications
- **Anti-cheat mechanisms** - Server-side validation and security systems
- **Game logic distribution** - Server vs client authority boundaries
